newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was inactive in the Panhandle area Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested.
Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers. No sales reported on slaughter steers or heifers; 7,500 head sold for the week to date of which 500 head were previously contracted
cattle to be shipped this week.
Confirmed: None Week Ago: 27,700 Year Ago: 17,300
Wk to date: 7,500 Week Ago: 37,400 Year Ago: 29,200
